programmes.d: The end of Montana's long winter is finally in sight. Tom and Nancy Oar are scrambling to get through the last of their winter works when a surprise call comes in from family.
Winter has finally come to a close, spelling big changes for Tom, who bids farewell to an old friend and packs his bags for Florida.
Everyday is a fight for their freedom and independence, but some battles are harder fought and push the men closer to the edge than ever before.
This season opens as a polar vortex sweeps across the nation and plunges America into a brutal early winter.
As winter tightens its grip on the nation, the mountain men fight the elements to stay alive.
Every year, hundreds of wildlife attacks and accidents occur in the pristine waters of the paradise, sunshine state of Florida.
On the rio Parana in northern Argentina, countless fishermen have been violently pulled into the water by unidentified creatures and some have even mysteriously disappeared.

Mysterious disappearances, brutal attacks, wounded people leaving trails of blood. Can a ruthless predator fish with razor-sharp teeth like the piranha, with its reputation as a true man eater, really be responsible?
Cyril's attention is captured by videos of two huge, unidentified creatures appearing off of Florida's coast - and discovering what these monsters are becomes an obsession. Is it even a fish?
Guyana's jungle in South America is wild and untamed, a remote no-man's land patrolled by jaguars, and where gold diggers still look for a bounty.
As the worst winter in decades rages across the nation, the Mountain Men must fight to stay on top of the food chain.
Marty makes a new start in some of Alaska's most unforgiving terrain, but his first solo flight into the Revelation Mountains becomes a dangerous ordeal.
An overflowing river of ice threatens to trap Marty Meierotto with no way out of Alaska's Revelation Mountains.
Rich runs his hunting dogs through a gauntlet of tests to determine which will become the new leader of the pack.
In Montana, Rich Lewis must defend his home from a mountain lion that has invaded his turf. In New Mexico, after a failed first attempt, Kyle Bell's son Ben steps up.
An Arctic blizzard howls down on the crew. The men try to convince the local hunters and trappers to help them haul fuel North. Ice reports show an advancing ice cap. Freezing spray blanket the crew.
Freezing spray covers the men. In the black of the Arctic night Steven’s watercraft sinks. The weather report looks grim. High winds almost capsize the fuel boat. The Whalers boat goes adrift.
For the first time this season the crew begin seeing Polar Bears roaming the frozen tundra. The weather continues to build and Steven has to make a decision on the fate of his watercraft.

Steven’s watercraft continues to sink. The expedition takes refuge on a deserted, frozen beach. It’s seal for lunch! The Whaling boat captain gets a funny feeling and changes everything for the expedition.
